description: Revenue Filter by JTA – A Data Scientist’s Visualization Tool Smarter Revenue Filtering – Designed for Precision and Ease Overview Revenue Filter is a custom Power BI visual designed to provide a more intuitive and flexible way to filter reports based on revenue columns. Instead of the traditional slider slicer, users can apply Excel-style filtering logic directly within Power BI. Choose from a dropdown with filtering conditions such as Greater Than, Less Than, Equals, Between, and more. Then, simply input a value to filter your data accordingly. The filter is clearly displayed, allowing for easier understanding and interaction. Whether you're a data analyst, business user, or finance professional, Revenue Filter enhances your ability to analyze and interact with revenue data in a simple, clear, and powerful way. Who Is It For? Data Analysts who need precise control over numeric filters. Business Users familiar with Excel who want the same filtering ease in Power BI. Report Creators aiming to improve user experience with cleaner filtering visuals. Customer Need Addressed The native Power BI slider slicer can be imprecise and visually unclear, especially for numeric fields like revenue. Revenue Filter solves this by offering an Excel-style filtering experience, making it clear which filters are applied and enabling more control over the report output. Key Features Excel-like…
